parameters.componentSubtitle: Bootstrap heroslider component for a block, which using drupal views.

description.component: A Drupal View Block component as heroslider for cycling through elements images/media or slides of text—like a heroslider.

id.name: Hero Slider ID
id.description: Set a unique id on the heroslider for optional controls, especially if the single page is using multiple hero sliders.

rows.name: Rows
rows.description: An array of slider items, Each item is a hero card

indicators.name: Indicators
indicators.description: Add indicators to the heroslider, alongside the previous/next controls.

controls_indicators_position.name: Controls & Indicators position
controls_indicators_position.description: Choose the location of the controls and indicators from (overlay|start|end|top|bottom).

interval.name: Interval
interval.description: The amount of time to delay between automatically cycling an item.

keyboard.name: Keyboard
keyboard.description: Whether the carousel should react to keyboard events.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: If set to `hover`, pauses the cycling of the carousel on mouseenter and resumes the cycling of the carousel on mouseleave. If set to false, hovering over the carousel won’t pause it. On touch-enabled devices, when set to `hover`, cycling will pause on touchend (once the user finished interacting with the carousel) for two intervals, before automatically resuming. This is in addition to the mouse behavior.

ride.name: Ride
ride.description: If set to `true`, autoplays the carousel after the user manually cycles the first item. If set to `carousel`, autoplays the carousel on load.

touch.name: Touch
touch.description: Whether the carousel should support left/right swipe interactions on touchscreen devices.

wrap.name: Wrap
wrap.description: Whether the carousel should cycle continuously or have hard stops.

heroslider_utility_classes.name: Utility Classes
heroslider_utility_classes.description: An array of utility classes. Use to add extra Bootstrap utility classes or custom CSS classes over to the heroslider element.

heroslider_indicators_utility_classes.name: Indicators Utility Classes
heroslider_indicators_utility_classes.description: An array of utility classes. Use to add extra Bootstrap utility classes or custom CSS classes over to the indicators element.

attributes.name: Attributes
attributes.description: HTML attributes to apply to the heroslider main wrapper tag.

indicators_attributes.name: Indicators Attributes
indicators_attributes.description: HTML attributes to apply to the indicators wrapper tag.

empty.name: Empty
empty.description: The HTML message when the Hero Slider has no slides
